label: held-out: spline, PCA-64 and centroids fit without the 45-degree arc; readouts on disjoint probe-fold clips; carriers = test clips

design.antipode_in_arc: source h - 180, target h, for each of the 8 held values h
design.midpoint_in_arc: source h - 90, target h + 90: the via-+90 route crosses the held arc at its midpoint, via -90 crosses kept values

routes.chord: line between smoothed-knot polyline points (run_two_route chord)
routes.chord_raw: line between raw-centroid polyline points (run_part2 linear_raw)

metric_notes.end_*_err: wrapped error (deg) at the last waypoint vs the target; the two spline routes end at the same point by construction
metric_notes.probe_radius_*: linear-probe (sin, cos) norm; start = unsteered carrier
metric_notes.*_intermediate_mass: mean over interior waypoints of the readout mass strictly between source and target on the route's half-ring (probe / MLP: one-hot of the readout snapped to the 64-value grid; eq9: Goodfire Eq. 9 distribution); chord scored on each half
metric_notes.*_ordering: Spearman(waypoint index, readout offset along the route's arc)
metric_notes.*_mid_err_to_route_mid: wrapped error at waypoint K//2 vs source + 90 (or - 90)
metric_notes.ci95: bootstrap over the 16 arcs of the per-arc mean
